text: The biggest behaviour changes this week are in MCP and connectors. #12207 marks Data Query Tools for MCP as billable, so users must acknowledge pricing before activation, and headless imports default to disabled. #12242 opens Power BI report deployment to all companies, not only evaluation ones, and adds workspace selection. #12064 lets the SharePoint connector handle hash and percent characters in paths through a new path format setting. #11560 adds a Peppol BIS 3.0 send path for self-billed purchase invoices and credit memos, and #11748 adds bonded-location handling to excise tax. In Shopify, #11604 captures the fulfillment delivery timestamp, while #12215, #12214, #12260 and #12139 fix document linking, currency mode storage, navigation and an action that should be disabled. Manufacturing and costing fixes include #11959, #12188, #12059, #11994 and #12124. Finance fixes cover #12141, #11848, #12127, #12135, #10182 and #11637. Other fixes address #12309, #12304, #12261, #12255, #12118, #12055 and #12145. The remaining work is cleanup: CLEAN27 removals in #12290 and #12293, guards in #12370, a set-based upgrade in #12307, and several BCQuality knowledge articles, such as #208 and #218.
